{"metadata":{"description":"Fold everything since the last checkpoint mark into an auto-generated report, replacing it in context while keeping the full log.","id":"gh:1326962701","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-rewind","slug":"dpskh/dsh-rewind","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Fold everything since the last checkpoint mark into an auto-generated report, replacing it in contex"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"t while keeping the full log."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"@dpskh/tool-rewind — exploration fold for the DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"One package, one entry plugin. Mounting `@dpskh/tool-rewind` provides `ctx.rewind` (a service that f"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"olds everything since the most recent checkpoint mark into an auto-generated report) and the model-f"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"acing `rewind` tool over it. The fold shadows the exploration's surface range with the report — the "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"same `surfaceOp: { op: 'replace' }` mechanism the DeepSeek Harness compaction seam uses — so subsequ"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ent requests no longer carry the exploration's intermediate steps (reads, searches, experiments), wh"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ile the durable log keeps the full exploration for audit. The report is produced by `ctx.llm` (auto-"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"generated); the mark is owned and served by the sibling `@dpskh/tool-checkpoint` plugin (`ctx.checkp"},{"id":"p4s8","text":"oint.latestMark` / `hasActive` / `completeFold`). This plugin writes **no session events of its own*"},{"id":"p4s9","text":"* — the fold commits only the core-vocabulary `user/message` replacement, so the durable session log"},{"id":"p4s10","text":" stays readable by any harness. No upstream package is modified."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Provider/model resolution order for the report call: configured overrides, then the session's last r"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"outed `request/header` config, then the agent's options. Missing all three fails loud."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The report call runs with thinking disabled when the route exposes an `off` reasoning effort — conde"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nsing an exploration is mechanical, and a reasoning model's thinking tokens otherwise compete with t"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"he report text under `maxTokens` (thinking can exhaust the budget before any text starts, leaving an"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" empty completion). Empty completions retry up to `maxSummarizationRetries`; an exhausted budget rej"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ects with a message carrying the finish reason and token usage, which the rejection message preserve"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ts with a message carrying the finish reason and token usage, which the rejection message preserves."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Working together"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The fold needs a marker: mount both plugins so `rewind` can collapse the exploration anchored by a `"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"checkpoint`. `rewind` alone has nothing to fold and fails with a no-checkpoint error; `checkpoint` a"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"lone records inert markers."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Contract"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- `ctx.rewind.rewind(agent, signal)` — read the session's latest mark through `ctx.checkpoint`; sele"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ct the surface span after it (never folding the rewind call itself, never splitting a tool-call/resu"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"lt pair at the trailing boundary); summarize the span over `ctx.llm`; then commit, in one synchronou"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"s block, a replacement `user/message` carrying the report with source marker `{ kind: 'plugin', plug"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"in: 'rewind' }` (`isRewindReportSource` recognizes it) and stamp the mark folded through `ctx.checkp"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"oint.completeFold`. Failures write nothing — the region stays intact, the mark stays active, and the"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" fold is retryable — and reject with a classified `RewindError` (`NO_CHECKPOINT`, `EMPTY_REGION`, `U"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"NBALANCED`, `FOLD_IN_PROGRESS`, `CHANGED`, `SHRINK`). A per-session in-process lock rejects concurre"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"nt folds. A mark taken mid-call — the checkpoint tool runs between its own tool-call and result — le"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"aves that result orphaned right after the mark; selection skips exactly that node, so the checkpoint"},{"id":"p13s11","text":" call's own pair stays visible and the fold starts at the exploration that follows. Exploration call"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"s issued in parallel with the checkpoint (same assistant message) leave their results behind the mar"},{"id":"p13s13","text":" [长行截断]
- `rewind` tool — no arguments → `{ markId, foldedNodes, start, end, foldedChars, reportChar"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"s }`, where `foldedChars` is the model-visible text the folded region contributed (assistant text, r"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"easoning, tool-call arguments, and tool outputs) and `reportChars` is the replacement report's lengt"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"h — the shrink accounting is visible in every result and error. Render intent: generic card.
- **Tur"},{"id":"p13s17","text":"n guard** — while the session has an active (unfolded) checkpoint mark, `agent/turn-stopping` inject"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"s a standing warning into the agent's next-step inbox (one per agent per turn), so the turn cannot e"},{"id":"p13s19","text":"nd until `rewind` folds the exploration. Activeness is read through `ctx.checkpoint`. A rewind that "},{"id":"p13s20","text":"legitimately fails (e.g. an empty region) cannot trap the turn in a warning loop."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Directly: the `rewind` tool call and its fold result. The replacement report message is model-visibl"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e from the next request on; the exploration's durable events stay in the log but out of the model-vi"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"sible surface. A `tool:rewind` system-prompt section makes fold discipline a standing instruction (r"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ewind immediately after the marked exploration, before unrelated work)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"#### KV Cache effect"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The report call reuses the session's system prompt and tool schemas so it stays a prefix of the last"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" routed request (warm prefix cache). The fold itself shifts the model-visible prefix of subsequent r"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"arm prefix cache). The fold itself shifts the model-visible prefix of subsequent requests by design."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Shrink check is char-based** — the report must be shorter than the folded region's model-visible"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" text (measured in characters, not tokens); the yardstick counts every block the model reads: assist"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ant/user text, reasoning, tool-call arguments, and tool outputs (recursively). A token-meter-based c"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"heck would be more precise; image blocks carry no text yardstick and are conservatively ignored.
- *"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"*Empty completions on routes without an `off` reasoning effort** — such routes keep their default th"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"inking; if thinking exhausts `maxTokens` the completion is empty and only the retry budget saves the"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" fold.
- **One fold per marker** — folding the same marker twice is rejected as an empty region; a n"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"ew exploration needs a fresh `checkpoint`.
- **Mid-exploration compaction** — if automatic compactio"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"n shadows part of the exploration before `rewind` runs, the fold covers whatever remains on the surf"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"ace; the storage-resident mark survives either way."}],"truncated":false}
